title: RDFR-CI: Reference Implementation, Scenario Library and Evaluation Harness
description: Supplementary and reproducibility package for the RDFR-CI paper. Includes the core governance equations, a 30-scenario illustrative library, uncertainty and sensitivity analyses, multi-agent authority demonstrations, publication figures and a pre-specified SWaT validation pipeline. SWaT raw data are not redistributed.
